title: The memory page: what a project's agents remember, corrected and reviewed by people
request: The owner: continue the memory plan to the end; 35.7 lets a person see and correct what the agents remember.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.7: a Memory tab on the project page; every line with its source; correct, review drafts; the browser test covers it.
plan: Add the pane on the existing /api/memory routes.
Review, fix, add the browser check, record, commit.

decisions.decision: The reviewer role is declared by a tick box, as on the evidence page
decisions.why: without accounts the server reads only the declared role; sending it silently would let anyone review know-how

decisions.decision: Let the browser check use the installed Chrome when asked (DCLAB_BROWSER_CHANNEL)
decisions.why: Playwright's own Chromium was not installed, and a download needs the owner's approval

decisions.decision: Write the narrower scope into the plan instead of building it now
decisions.why: seeing other people's lines needs accounts and a policy the owner has not set

change: web/src/views/project.html (the Memory pane), web/src/features.js, the generated static app, scripts/browser_e2e.py (memory check), tests.

findings.defect: In local mode the owner could not review or correct know-how from the page
findings.scenario: an accepted lesson's Correct answered 403 and know-how drafts were never listed
findings.cause: the page sent no role, and without accounts the server reads only the declared role
findings.fix: a tick box declares the reviewer role and the page sends it

findings.defect: The browser test did not open the Memory tab
findings.scenario: a wide table or a broken button would pass make browser-test
findings.cause: the checks open each page on its default tab
findings.fix: a memory check: open the tab, correct a line, read it back, measure at 375 px

findings.defect: Nothing showed that an edit on the page is the next brief's text
findings.scenario: the correction route and the brief were tested apart
findings.fix: an API test corrects with the page's call and reads the agent's brief

findings.defect: The plan's 'owner sees every scope' and edit/retire were not built
findings.scenario: a signed-in owner sees only their own person lines
findings.cause: the route's chain is the caller's own
findings.fix: written as not built in the plan's status

findings.defect: A refused correction or review showed a success toast
findings.cause: the toast was called without ok:false

findings.defect: A late answer could draw another project's memory
findings.scenario: switch from A to B quickly: A's lines under B, then Correct sends B's id
findings.cause: no check that the project was still the same
findings.fix: the answer is dropped when the project changed

outcome: The Memory tab is built and reviewed: a person sees what the agents read with its source, corrects a line (the next brief carries it), and reviews drafts after declaring the role; the browser test covers it at 1280 and 375 px.
lessons: A page that calls a role-checked route must say which role it acts in, and a person must declare it; a silent header is a hole.
A tab not opened by the browser test is not tested, however well its API is.
risks: The owner cannot yet see other people's person lines.
